title: Power BI workspace cleanup cycle
subtitle: Review ownership, external access, stale content and audit records each quarter.

steps.title: Inventory every workspace
steps.evidence: list every workspace with admins, members, reports and datasets;

steps.title: Assign two business admins
steps.evidence: assign two admins from the business team per workspace;

steps.title: Confirm external sharing
steps.evidence: find workspaces shared with external users, confirm access and restrict external sharing in tenant settings;

steps.title: Retire unused reports
steps.evidence: retire reports, dashboards and datasets unused for 90 days;

steps.title: Repeat quarterly and record proof
steps.evidence: repeat quarterly and record every confirmation for audits.
